item.title: Anna de Peyster, Author and Second Wife of Rupert Murdoch, Dies at 81
item.description: The mother of Elisabeth, Laclan and James served on the News Corp. board for eight years and wrote three novels.

item.title: Ted Sarandos Says James Cameron Is “Part of the Paramount Disinformation Campaign” on Warner Bros. Deal
item.description: Cameron had claimed that Netflix will ultimately renege on a pledge to keep Warner Bros. movies in theaters for 45 days.

item.title: Filmmaker Nicholas Jarecki’s Chummy Relationship With Jeffrey Epstein Revealed
item.description: The writer-director of 'Arbitrage' enjoyed friendly, bawdy exchanges with the disgraced financier — until it went south over the financing of the 2012 film 'Arbitrage': "I still think you acted like a dickhead over the whole thing."

item.title: ‘Face/Off’ Sequel Loses Director Adam Wingard
item.description: Paramount is developing a follow-up to John Woo's 1997 action favorite that starred John Travolta and Nicolas Cage.

item.title: ‘Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem 2’ Moves Up to August 2027
item.description: The feature is just one of multiple 'Ninja Turtles' projects new Paramount is working on.

item.title: These 10 JFK Jr. and Carolyn Bessette Books Are Trending Amidst ‘Love Story’ Buzz
item.description: From memoirs by dear friends to coffee table books on Bessette's signature style, here are the titles moving up the charts given the series' growing popularity.

item.title: The Best Hotels, Restaurants and Shops to Visit in the Cotswolds — the Hamptons of London
item.description: From Michelin-starred pubs to a luxury outlet village, here’s your ultimate style guide to England’s most glamorous countryside escape.

item.title: Eric Dane’s Friends Launch GoFundMe to Support Actor’s Two Daughters After His Death
item.description: The 'Grey's Anatomy' and 'Euphoria' star died on Thursday at the age of 53 after he revealed in April that he was diagnosed with ALS.
